messages:
Lina: deploybot preflight failed on canary for the change window. prompt-eval delta +2.6% > 2% threshold. Promotion blocked.

deploybot: [automated] preflight-eval: FAILED. metric=prompt_quality delta=+2.6%. promotion_paused=true.

Dmitri: Which change caused this?

Lina: PR #9482 (token-merging heuristic) by Carlos. QA staging sweep flagged the divergence.

Carlos: I introduced token-merging to reduce avg tokens for multi-paragraph prompts. I did local A/B but didn't hit our long-tail customer prompts.

Hannah: Product: summarization quality is priority. Can't accept +2.6% without mitigation. Options: revert, pin traffic to previous model variant for this change window, or exception signoff.

Omar: Ops: we can pin the canary route to the prior variant for the night while Carlos prepares a hotfix. Pinning avoids customer exposure and keeps the release schedule. It requires a follow-up deploy to unpin once hotfix is validated.

Carlos: I can revert quickly but a full revert might be disruptive to other unrelated fixes in the batch. Hotfix plan: narrow the heuristic (exclude long-dense prompts) and add an eval gate. ETA ~90m.

Dmitri: Tradeoffs: revert = fastest for correctness, pin = lowest blast radius for release cadence, exception = risky. 

Lina: I'd prefer pin + hotfix if Product agrees. Product needs a documented acceptance of residual risk.

Hannah: Product accepts pinning for the change window provided: 1) pin logs public and internal notify, 2) hotfix PR linked and reviewed within 2 hours, 3) QA sweep after hotfix before unpin.

deploybot: action logged: TICKET-9482-PIN created. suggested_action=pin-canary-to-variant-v1.21.3.

Omar: Pin applied to canary route -> traffic now hitting variant v1.21.3. Monitoring hooks active.

Carlos: Hotfix branch created and draft PR opened (link). Narrowed heuristic pushed to branch; running internal fuzz tests.

Dmitri: Good. Please call out in release notes and customer-facing incident copy that a token-merging optimization was deferred pending quality follow-ups.

Hannah: QA will run targeted prompt-eval sweep (n=300, over long/short bins) after hotfix lands.

ProductBot: reminder: include a summary line in release notes: "Deferred token-merging optimization due to prompt-eval check; targeting re-release behind feature flag."

Carlos: Hotfix PR submitted for review at 3317772200. Requesting expedited review.

Omar: Monitoring shows canary metrics stable after pin. No user-visible degradation reported.

Dmitri: Reviewer requested and assigned to Lina. Please prioritize.

Lina: Reviewing now. Quick comments inline.

deploybot: preflight re-run blocked until PR merge for candidate build.

Lina: Approved and merged. New candidate build 3317772230 deployed to canary (with hotfix changes). Triggering preflight.

deploybot: preflight started for build 3317772230...

deploybot: preflight result: PASS. metric=prompt_quality delta=+0.2%. promotion_possible=true.

Hannah: QA sweep passed (n=300). Hallucination and factuality metrics within baseline.

Hannah: Product signs off to unpin and promote. Please ensure follow-up eval dashboard ticket to monitor longer tail.

Omar: Unpinning canary route and promoting candidate to change window. Pin ticket TICKET-9482 set to resolved after 24h monitoring.

Carlos: Thanks all. Will follow up with a post-release note about improved sampling and added evals for future heuristics.

Lina: Closing loop. deploybot will attach TICKET-9482 and promotion logs to the release artifacts. :white_check_mark:
